list.title: Clinical Results
list.content:
This sunscreen has been tested by a leading independent third-party (Centre for Cruelty Free Testing) for the following claims:


⚫In Vitro test: SPF 54.58 PA ++++

⚫In Vivo* test: SPF 50.17 PA++++

⚫Lightest Sunscreen in India: Comparative testing with top-selling Indian competitors; determined through a blind sensorial study conducted on 32 volunteers by an independent third-party

⚫Free from Harmful Endocrine Disruptors: Phthalates, Parabens, UV Filters (Octisalate, Homosalate, Octocrylene, Oxybenzone, Octinoxate, Avobenzone), Triclosan, Lead, and Cadmium

⚫Dermatologically Tested: Verified for skin irritation as per the IS 4011: 2018 standard

⚫ Sweat & Water Resistant: Upto 80 mins

*Note: In Vivo test is the GOLD STANDARD for SPF test. It directly measures sunscreen effectiveness on human skin, ensuring accurate and reliable results.

list.title: How to Use Ultra Light Sunscreen SPF50+ ?
list.content:
Step 1
On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck.

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this Ultra Light SPF 50+ Sunscreen regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.

Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it
Suitable for
• All skin types
Helps
• Protect skin from UVA and UVB rays • Deeply hydrates skin • Improve skin tone • Targets and heals acne • Leaves skin feeling smooth

list.title: Is this suitable for all skin types?
list.content: It is suitable for all skin types. AcZero technology present makes it completely safe even for active acne or acne-prone skin. But since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine.

list.title: Will it leave a white cast?
list.content: Be Bodywise Ultra Light Sunscreen has a lightweight aqua gel like texture and doesn't leave a white cast

list.title: Does it have fragrance?
list.content: No, this sunscreen has no added fragrance.

list.title: Is it sweat/water resistant?
list.content: Yes, it is clinically proven to have water & sweat resistance, upto 80 mins.

list.title: Is it oily?
list.content: No, the formulation is aquagel based. Thus, it does not feel oily or sticky on face.
